sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sq(f):
    out={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(x[0] for x in b); c0=min(x[1] for x in b)
        if 15<r0<45 and n['pixels']<=20 and n['color'] not in ('W','g','G','c','B'):
            out[(r0,c0)]=n['color']
    return out
def show(s):
    R=[s.get((21,c)) for c in (21,27,33,39)]
    G=[s.get((35,c)) for c in (21,27,33,39)]
    return "red=%s green=%s"%(R,G)
s=sq(current_frame); print(show(s))
# swap red1<->green1
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':22,'col':22},{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':22}])
s=sq(current_frame); print("after swap1:", show(s))
assert s.get((21,21))=='O' and s.get((35,21))=='p', "swap1 unexpected"
# swap red2<->green3
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':22,'col':28},{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':34}])
s=sq(current_frame); print("after swap2:", show(s))
assert s.get((21,27))=='R' and s.get((35,33))=='N', "swap2 unexpected"
action(['SPACE'])
r=last_action_result
print("SPACE:", {k:r.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
print("level:", current_frame.level, show(sq(current_frame)))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
